verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.text: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

verses.html: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.text: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.html: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

verses.html: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.text: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.html: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
verses.text: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

verses.html: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
